classification: Exact small-window pilot with complete ex-post factorization; not a speed benchmark.

definition.world: S_B={p*m: p odd prime<=B, m odd, 3<=m<=B}
definition.window: I=[max(3,G(B)-28),G(B)] restricted to odd addresses; G(B)=min(B^2,3B+4)
definition.suffix_cutoff: a*=min over composite n in I of latest_witness(n)
definition.sparse_count: Number of distinct latest_witness values; a specific covering set, not a proven minimum-cardinality cover.
definition.active: T_p(I) minus the union of T_q(I) for all q>p is nonempty; equivalent to latest_witness(n)=p for some n.

additional_valid_flash_transition.scope: Valid flash from starting world 71; not part of the canonical route starting at 3.

pancake_identity.formula: (T_p(I) minus union_{q>p} T_q(I)) = {composite n in I: P_plus(n)=p} = union_{k>=1} p^k H_
pancake_identity.meaning: Every residual address has a power of p times a factor built only from smaller odd primes; H_

record_prime_axis_suffix_upper_bounds.classification: Analytic upper bounds for suffixes of literal prime axes, on known composite positions only.
record_prime_axis_suffix_upper_bounds.argument: If d divides n and n>d^2, each prime divisor q of n is at most n/d: q divides d and is at most d<n/d, or q divides n/d. Therefore min_n max D_B(n) is at most n/d for any exhibited n.

positive_absorption_example.assumption: P is the declared known prime.
positive_absorption_example.scope: The new axis P covers this particular address formerly covered by axis 3; no whole-window absorption claim is made.

limitations: These are upper bounds, not the exact record-window cutoff.
They do not count the depth or size of arbitrary saved refinement rules.
They do not prove a lower bound on the running time of every possible method.
The plus-four example approaches 3/53 from above; 3/53 alone is not its strict upper bound.
a* is computed after complete factorization of every small pilot address; this cost and rank-sieve construction are included in pilot timings.
This does not supply an efficient way to obtain a* or a sufficient exact world at the record P.
A minimum-length full suffix of prime axes differs from a minimum-cardinality sparse cover and from saved composite refinement rules.
Activity is local to the current window. No-shadow and absorption-by-later-axes are recorded separately.
Absence of a reactivation in the finite canonical sample would not prove permanent inactivity.
Historical speed benchmarks are not rerun or changed by this pilot.
